_why: Per-provider facts a generic translator cannot know. Each of these three fields caused a real failure on 2026-07-27: a stale model id 404'd 19/40 keys, a thinking model with no token headroom returned empty content, and OpenAI's 120ms default rate-limit was applied to a provider with a ~15 RPM tier. Add a provider by adding a row.

gemini-free._note: Native engine, NOT the OpenAI-compat endpoint: generativelanguage.../v1beta/openai/ returns bodyless 400s for this tool's zod-generated response_format. Free tier needs no card.

ollama.model: REQUIRED — whatever `ollama list` shows, e.g. gemma3:12b
ollama._note: THE recommended local option: one install, `ollama pull <model>`, done. Uses the tool's NATIVE ollama engine, not Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 — compat layers are less complete than native APIs (Google's returns bodyless 400s for a request its native API accepts). batchMaxTokens is raised from the tool's own Ollama default of 2048 (cli_helpers.ts:147), which starves a thinking model: deliberation eats the budget and the answer is never written. No API key needed.

local-openai-compatible.model: REQUIRED — the model id your llama-server serves
local-openai-compatible._note: Start llama-server with --reasoning off (or --reasoning-budget 0). A thinking model returns EMPTY content here: the deliberation fills message.reasoning_content and the token budget runs out before any answer is written. Any OpenAI-compatible server works — llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio.

openai._note: Untested here — no key. Rate limit is the package's own default for tier-1.
